headline: Torino's winning run against Monza's better attack
summary: Torino have won two Serie A games in a row and host Monza on Friday. Monza, though, arrive off a 4-0 win over Cagliari, average 1.98 expected goals a game — more than Torino's 1.36 — and won 1-0 at this stadium in the Coppa Italia on 1 September. Varela has 6 league goals. Across 10 bookmakers, with the margin removed, Torino are 44.2% favourites, but the handicap makes them only a quarter of a goal better. Both teams to score is priced at 53.3%.
read: Torino are clear but narrow favourites at home, lifted by two straight wins and a sold-out crowd. Monza arrive with the better underlying attack — 1.98 xG per game and Varela's six-goal start — but five absentees thin their squad for a Friday night away trip.

facts.fact: Torino won 3-0 at Parma on Sunday, their second consecutive Serie A victory, with Giovanni Simeone scoring twice and Che Adams heading in.
facts.meaning: Torino arrive in the best form of their season, and the home crowd is responding.

facts.fact: Torino are the favourites at 44.2% to win, against Monza's 27.7% and a 28.1% draw.
facts.meaning: The market sees a clear but not dominant home side — Monza are rated closer than a bottom-half visitor would normally be.

facts.fact: Monza beat Cagliari 4-0 at home, ending Cagliari's four-game unbeaten run.
facts.meaning: Juric's side arrive off their most emphatic result of the season and will not be overawed.

facts.fact: Monza average 1.98 xG per game over their last five — more than a goal better than Torino's 1.36.
facts.meaning: Monza are creating the better chances; Torino's wins have come with less attacking control.

facts.fact: Monza's injury list runs to five: Y. Maye (131 minutes), E. Zeballos (71 minutes, 1 goal), M. Pessina (knee), I. Toure and J. Ziolkowski.
facts.meaning: Juric is short in defence and midfield depth for a Friday night away game.

facts.fact: Tuttosport reports Torino's advance ticket sales are soaring, with a near-full and lively stadium expected on Friday.
Gazzetta dello Sport reports that Gustavo Varela has scored six goals in six Serie A appearances this season, including a double against Cagliari.
facts.meaning: Monza have a genuine in-form scorer — the main threat to a Torino clean sheet.

facts.fact: Both teams to score is priced at 53.3%, the only notable price move in recent days, up 1.3 points.
facts.meaning: More likely than not that both teams score — a game with chances at both ends.

sources.fact: Torino won 3-0 at Parma for their second consecutive victory, with Giovanni Simeone scoring twice and Che Adams heading in.
Torino's advance ticket sales for the Monza match are soaring after two wins in a row, with a near-full and very lively stadium expected.
Torino coach Ignazio Abate said ahead of the Monza game that the team is fighting with itself and that Nikola Vlasic must stay calm.
Gazzetta dello Sport reports that Torino's Bragança has impressed immediately under Abate, scoring against Udinese and starring at Parma.
Fortini was absent from Torino's squad for the Parma match, according to Toro News.
Monza coach Ivan Juric, after the 4-0 win over Cagliari, warned Abate that Monza will approach the Torino game as they did in the Coppa Italia meeting.
Monza beat Cagliari 4-0 at home, ending Cagliari's four-game unbeaten run, for their second Serie A win of the season.
Gustavo Varela has scored six goals in six Serie A appearances this season, including a double against Cagliari.
